title: Drift Championship Round 1
description: Experience the excitement as the season begins with the country's best drift drivers competing for championship points.

title: Night Drift Festival
description: Enjoy thrilling night-time drifting, live music, food vendors, and entertainment for motorsport fans of all ages.

title: Drift Skills Workshop
description: Professional instructors teach beginners and intermediate drivers the fundamentals of safe and controlled drifting.

title: Pro-Am Drift Challenge
description: Professional and amateur drivers compete together in an exciting head-to-head drifting competition.

title: Summer Drift Festival
description: A full day of drifting, car exhibitions, merchandise, food stands, family activities, and live performances.

title: National Drift Finals
description: Watch Nigeria's best drift drivers compete for the National Drift Championship title in the season finale.

title: International Drift Invitational
description: Top international drift drivers join local champions in an elite invitational competition featuring spectacular tandem drifting.

title: End of Season Drift Expo
description: Celebrate the end of the drifting season with awards, custom car displays, sponsor exhibitions, and fan meet-and-greets.
